introduce: Lie on the floor with your hands behind your ears. Raise your knees and close your right elbow toward your left knee, then close your left elbow toward your right knee. Repeat the exercise.
name: BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominals.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
If you can see your elbows, please open your chest.
Exhale when lifting your body and inhale when lowering.
You should feel your abs burning.
You shouldn't feel too much strain in your neck.

introduce:
Start in the push-up position, but keep your arms straight. 

Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens your abdomen and back muscles.
name: STRAIGHT-ARM PLANK

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your hands directly underneath your shoulders.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Do not sink your lower back or raise your hips in the air.
Breathe deeply.
Too easy for you? Add weight on your lower back.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise really works on your core and lower back.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Sit on the floor, lift your legs up at a 45 degree angle, and lean your upper body back at a 45 degree angle. Stretch your arms forward. Hold this position.\n\nDon't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.
name: V-HOLD

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Try to keep your legs as straight as you can.
Please don\'t arch your back.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, lower your feet on the floor.
This exercise targets the rectus abdominis and obliques.
This exercise enhances core strength.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your left foot left, right foot slightly inward.

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, and lengthen your spine upward. Exhale, shift hips right and bend torso left until your left hand to your left shin or the floor. Inhale, stretch your right arm toward the ceiling, and gaze at it.

Hold this position. Inhale and exhale for several breaths, focusing on the sensation of stretching and the lengthening of your spine.
name: TRIANGLE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it's too hard, put your left hand on your left leg instead of the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your right foot left, left foot slightly inward

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, and lengthen your spine upward. Exhale, shift hips left and bend torso right until your right hand to your right shin or the floor. Inhale, stretch your left arm toward the ceiling, and gaze at it.

Hold this position. Inhale and exhale for several breaths, focusing on the sensation of stretching and the lengthening of your spine.
name: TRIANGLE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your right hand on your right leg instead of the floor.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder width apart. 

Raise your hands overhead with palms up toward the ceiling. 

Use one of your hands to grab the other. Bend your body side to side.
name: STANDING BACK STRETCHES

tips.text: Exhale when you bend down, and inhale when you come back.
This exercise helps stretch your spine.

introduce:
Stand straight with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Lift your arms to the sides at shoulder height, and bend your knees slightly. 

Then push your hips back, bend your body and touch the left toe with your right hand. Return to the starting position. 

Switch sides and repeat the exercise.
name: STANDING CROSSOVER TOE TOUCHES

tips.text: Keep your back straight the whole time.
Exhale when you bend your body down, and inhale when you get up.
If it is too hard for you, bend in your knees more when you reach for your toes.
You should feel your oblique muscles burning.
This exercise helps tone your obliques and improve core strength.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. 

As you inhale, lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the ground, firming your shoulder blades onto your back. Imagine someone grasping your hands, gently pulling you back, to come up higher.

Hold this position. Use the inhale to support the lift of your head, chest, arms, and legs.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pubic bone on the floor when lifting your legs.
Inhale to lift higher. Exhale to release your tension.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. Put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Inhale as you use your core muscles to slowly lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen your spine and feel the stretch along your back and legs. Exhale to soften your hips and release tension.
name: HALF PLOUGH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
All the pressure should be in your abdominal region.
Keep your legs straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax your hips and release the tension.
This exercise strengthens your core and helps you reduce belly fat.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, draw your belly in, and roll your shoulders back and down.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, keeping your spine long. Place your hands on your shins.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths through your nose. Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to relax and release deeper into the fold.
name: HALF FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Bend from your hips instead of your waist.
Keep your legs straight but don\'t lock your knees.
Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine.
Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to release deeper into the fold.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
This exercise strengthens your back.

introduce:
Stand upright with your arms by your sides. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upward. 

Inhale as you raise your arms overhead and lift your heels. Balance on your toes and lengthen through your whole body. Hold the pose with slow, steady breaths. Feel your shoulders relax and your shoulder blades sink. 

Exhale, lower your heels and arms back to the starting position.
name: PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise stretches your entire body and improves your balance.
Inhale to stretch up, exhale to lower back.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor. 

Inhale as you press through your hands firmly into the floor. Straighten your arms and lift your chest. Slightly lift your thighs off the ground. Gaze forward or slightly upward.

Hold the position with deep and steady breath. Inhale to expand your chest and lengthen your spine, exhale to soften your shoulders, relax your neck, and keep your arms and core stable.
name: UPWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Rotate your shoulders back and down.
Keep your legs engaged, don\'t slouch them on the floor.
Keep your neck natural, don\'t strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your chest, abdomen, and spine.
This exercise can firm your buttocks and thighs.
Inhale to lift your chest. Exhale to soften your shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your legs together. Inhale to lift your arms overhead. Exhale, bend your knees and sink your hips back as if sitting on a chair. 

Press your palms together in a prayer position at your chest. On an exhale, twist your torso to the left, hooking your right elbow to the outside of your left knee. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and release tension in your torso.
name: REVOLVED CHAIR POSE LEFT

tips.text: Don’t let your knees go over your toes.
Keep your weight in your heels.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax and deepen the twist.
This exercise stretches your lower back and spine.
This exercise tones your lower body and improves your balance.

introduce:
Stand with your legs together. Inhale to lift your arms overhead. Exhale, bend your knees and sink your hips back as if sitting on a chair. 

Press your palms together in a prayer position at your chest. On an exhale, twist your torso to the right, hooking your left elbow to the outside of your right knee. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and release tension in your torso.
name: REVOLVED CHAIR POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Don't let your knees go over your toes
Keep your weight in your heels.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax and deepen the twist.
This exercise stretches your lower back and spine.
This exercise tones your lower body and improves your balance.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your left leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your left elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your right leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your right elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Take a deep inhale and step your left foot forward while turning the right foot out about 60 degrees.

Exhale as you lower your body until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms overhead, palms facing each other.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths. Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest, exhale to engage your core, and stay stable.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ LEFT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to engage your core.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Take a deep inhale and step your right foot forward while turning the left foot out about 60 degrees.

Exhale as you lower your body until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms overhead, palms facing each other.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths. Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest, exhale to engage your core, and stay stable.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to engage your core.

introduce:
Stand tall with your feet together. Take a big step back with your right leg, toes pointing slightly in. 

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides, palms down. Exhale, bend your left knee until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Press down through your big toe for balance.

Hold this position while breathing slowly and deeply. Inhale, lift your chest and lengthen your spine. Exhale, deepen the stretch.
name: WARRIOR Ⅱ LEFT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Keep your torso in the middle.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
Don\'t let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and hamstrings.
Inhale to strengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Stand tall with your feet together. Take a big step back with your left leg, toes pointing slightly in. 

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides, palms down. Exhale, bend your right knee until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Press down through your big toe for balance.

Hold this position while breathing slowly and deeply. Inhale, lift your chest and lengthen your spine. Exhale, deepen the stretch.
name: WARRIOR Ⅱ RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Keep your torso in the middle.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and hamstrings.
Inhale to strengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.
